svg.title: A trace plot that mixed and a trace plot that did not
svg.desc: Top: a chain with step size 0.7 fills a horizontal band around 5.0 within a few dozen iterations. Bottom: a chain with step size 0.02 climbs slowly from 2 and has still not arrived after two thousand iterations.
svg.text: accepts about 70 in 100, and is worth about 264 independent draws out of 2,000
accepts about 97 in 100, is worth about 3 independent draws out of 2,000, and is still climbing at the end
Same target, same number of iterations, different step size
A trace plot is evidence about the algorithm only. Neither panel says anything about whether the model suits the help desk.
